capabilities: Hide sidebars, toolbars, tab bars and padding
Toggle a fullscreen zen mode with only the note visible
Choose which tabs the sidebar opens with
Adjust file explorer spacing and editor scroll offset
Show Git status, pull and push in a sidebar tab
extras: Git sync tab is off by default; the README states Zen UI runs no shell commands and makes no network requests, and that a reload leaves Zen mode.
problem: Obsidian's sidebars, toolbars, tab bars and padding take up screen space even when a user does not need them.
summary: Interface plugin that hides Obsidian sidebars, toolbars, tab bars and padding, with an optional fullscreen zen mode that shows only the note.
